Chapter 931: Chapter 26 Return (End Of This Volume, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 931: Chapter 26 Return (End of this volume, please subscribe)

The consciousness of the Immortal Realm can easily mobilize the entire power of the Immortal Realm. Even the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, a being of the twelfth layer, must retreat before the vast power of the Immortal Realm.

The entire Immortal Realm is like the body of the Immortal Realm’s consciousness. Even if Lin Yuan enters the heart of the Origin Core, he cannot harness the power of the Immortal Realm from here.

However, the consciousness of the Immortal Realm can still control the myriad rules themselves and contend with Lin Yuan.

After all, the heart of the Origin Core is where the myriad rules exist, and the consciousness of the Immortal Realm also has control over these myriad rules themselves.

But after Lin Yuan bred the Chaos Rule, he naturally suppressed all myriad rules, and the consciousness of the Immortal Realm sensed that even with control over myriad rules, it could not deal with Lin Yuan, and thus began to fear.

After all, Lin Yuan, as of this moment, could erase the consciousness of the Immortal Realm by force if he so wished.

Of course, the consciousness of the Immortal Realm still has the ability to resist, which is to actively self-destruct, leading to the collapse of the Immortal Realm. In doing so, the myriad rules of the Immortal Realm will actively converge into the Chaos Rule to counter Lin Yuan.

But in doing so, the consciousness of the Immortal Realm will also collapse. Although a destroyed Immortal Realm would still be reborn and give birth to a new consciousness of the Immortal Realm,

The future consciousness of the Immortal Realm would not be the same as the current one.

Therefore,

Unless absolutely necessary, the consciousness of the Immortal Realm will definitely not choose to self-destruct; that is only slightly better than being erased. “Rest assured, I will not erase you.”

Lin Yuan said casually, mainly because erasing the consciousness of the Immortal Realm brings him no benefit.

Now that Lin Yuan has more or less comprehended the rules at the heart of the Origin Core of the Immortal Realm, erasing its consciousness does not help him much.

In simple terms, whatever Lin Yuan could gain from the consciousness of the Immortal Realm, he has already obtained.

If Lin Yuan truly pressures the consciousness of the Immortal Realm into a corner, forcing it to self-destruct and perish along with him—

Lin Yuan would be indifferent. After all, he could return to the Main Universe at any moment, but the efforts of spreading Martial Tao over a thousand years in the thirty-three Immortal Domains of the Immortal Realm would then have been in vain.

If the Immortal Realm itself ceases to exist, the Martial Tao cultivators would naturally vanish as well. “However, since the Chaos Rule can restrain the consciousness of a realm, I wonder about the consciousness of the Main Universe…” Lin Yuan mused to himself.

Although the Immortal Realm barely ranks on the same level as the Main Universe, the essence of the rules contained within the Main Universe is surely far superior to that of the Immortal Realm.

For instance, at the heart of the Origin Core of the Immortal Realm, comprehending the Pillar-level Fusion Rules to the Seventh Realm is the limit.

But at the heart of the Origin Core of the Main Universe, the limit could rise to the Eighth Realm or even the Ninth Realm. “Forget it, I reckon I can’t even enter the Primordial Lands of the Main Universe…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The reason he can enter this core is not because of his own strength, but because of his understanding of the Space-Time Rule, which surpasses the Space-Time of the Immortal Realm at the Seventh Realm.

As for forcing his way in? The vast power of the Immortal Realm is enough to suppress even the typical ultimate beings of the twelfth layer, with the Ancestor of the Immortal Path as an example.

And the space-time of the Main Universe is even more vast than that of the Immortal Realm.

To surpass the space-time of the Main Universe, Lin Yuan’s perception of space-time would likely have to reach the Eighth Realm or even the Ninth Realm.

And the Eighth Realm, the Ninth Realm of space-time perception?

Even for Lin Yuan, it’s a field he’s confident of touching only after stepping into the twelfth layer.

You should know, one of Xuanhuang’s most proud methods is his perception of space-time at the Ninth Realm.

Even among the peak powerhouses of the Chaos Realm, very few have space-time perception reaching the Ninth Realm. “I’m leaving.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the consciousness of the Immortal Realm, his figure vanishing from the heart of the Origin Core.

After spawning the Chaos Rule, Lin Yuan has reached the limit in all aspects.

At least this place is of no further assistance to him. “Is he gone?”

The consciousness of the Immortal Realm paused slightly and after repeatedly probing its surroundings, confirmed that Lin Yuan was no longer there and immediately began to mobilize the entire power of the Immortal Realm to heavily guard the core.

Although the consciousness of the Immortal Realm does not have specific thoughts, it has developed a strong instinct, which is to not want to see Lin Yuan again.

After all, nobody wants to confront an existence that can completely erase themselves. …

The Dao Ancestor Continent.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path is still focused on the rule fluctuations that pervade the Primordial Lands. “Hm?” “Has it stabilized again?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path raised an eyebrow, slightly relieved.

Although the disorderly and chaotic rule fluctuations cannot affect him, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path still prefers ‘order’.

Suddenly.

At that moment, a figure silently condensed in front of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path. “What?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s expression fluctuated wildly, for this is his Daoist sanctuary, akin to his domain, where the Ancestor of the Immortal Path controls everything, yet someone got inside undetected.

It wasn’t until the figure appeared before his eyes that the Ancestor of the Immortal Path noticed. “The Ancestor of Martial Arts?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path gazed at the figure not far away, recognizing it to be the Ancestor of Martial Arts. “Ancestor of the Immortal Path.”

Lin Yuan gave a slight smile, “I have come to see you today to bid farewell.”

Indeed, after breeding the Chaos Rule, the Primordial Lands no longer hold significance for Lin Yuan.

With the remaining decades of his stay, Lin Yuan plans to wander about.

Over the past millennium, Lin Yuan’s incarnations have nearly visited every corner of the Immortal Realm.

Yet beyond the Immortal Realm, in the vast void, Lin Yuan has not explored much.

Mainly because the void is so vast that even with Lin Yuan’s perception of space-time, he would find it dull and tedious over time.

But now it’s different. Having realized the Chaos Rule, the desolate void has, in Lin Yuan’s eyes, started to become slightly interesting. “Farewell?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s complexion changed slightly.

Lin Yuan plans to leave the Primordial Lands for only one reason, that is, the rules manifesting from the Primordial Lands are no longer of any help to him.

But how is that possible?

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path has cultivated in seclusion in the Primordial Lands for countless eons, and even now, he still feels that the manifest rules of the Primordial Lands resonate with him.

And yet, Lin Yuan intends to leave after merely a thousand years? “Did Fellow Daoist achieve a breakthrough?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path asked tentatively.

At this moment, the aura Lin Yuan exudes far surpasses that of a thousand years ago. The Ancestor of the Immortal Path feels tremendous pressure, especially given Lin Yuan’s ability to appear before him silently.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path is almost certain that the recent rule anomaly that affected the entire Immortal Realm originated from Lin Yuan. “Something like that.”

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

Nurturing the Chaos Rule has brought improvements to Lin Yuan that are nearly equivalent to transcending the ultimate boundary.

If not for the infusion of the Chaos Void Origin while attempting the ultimate breakthrough in the Main Universe, the benefits would almost be akin to that very transcendence. “Something like that?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s thoughts were somewhat complicated. He didn’t know in what way Lin Yuan had broken through; at least, he could not sense the presence of a fellow Ancestral Master.

But at this moment, Lin Yuan indeed posed a significant threat to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, a threat on the same level of strength. “After I leave, I hope you will look after the many cultivators of the Martial Tao lineage,”

Lin Yuan spoke.

This statement could be a request, but also a warning.

Once the stay limit is reached, Lin Yuan will completely leave the Immortal Realm.

Thus, Lin Yuan specifically came to remind the Ancestor of the Immortal Path. “I will certainly do my best for the lineage of Fellow Daoist,”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path said seriously.

Even if Lin Yuan had not achieved a breakthrough, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path would not dare to harm the Martial Tao lineage, let alone now, after the breakthrough?

Before his breakthrough, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, although unable to do anything to Lin Yuan, equally, Lin Yuan couldn’t do anything to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path either.

And now? The Ancestor of the Immortal Path still can’t affect Lin Yuan, yet Lin Yuan remains capable of posing a threat to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path. “I hope so.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Even after ending this traversal, Lin Yuan could still keep an eye on the changes within the Martial Tao of the Immortal Realm.

After reaching the Seventh Realm of space-time, Lin Yuan’s control over the Myriad Realms Gate has elevated by a level; he can slightly sense it even without the transmission of information from the Demon Tree. “I wonder…”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path intended to inquire more about the details of Lin Yuan’s breakthrough but realized that the latter had already disappeared. “Ancestor of Martial Arts.”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s gaze was slightly complicated.

The time the Ancestor of Martial Arts has emerged is incredibly short, just over a thousand years to this day.

But the influence on the Immortal Realm and even the Ancestor himself is unprecedented. “Could the breakthrough of the Ancestor of Martial Arts be related to the consciousness of the Immortal Realm?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path pondered, also yearning for a breakthrough, especially one of great magnitude like that of the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

With this in mind, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s figure vanished, and before long, he appeared outside the core area of the Primordial Lands.

Rumbling sounds.

Before the Ancestor of the Immortal Path could react, he felt the overwhelming force of the Immortal Realm engulfing him. “Begone!”

The consciousness of the Immortal Realm emitted fluctuations, and without hesitation, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path retreated rapidly, leaving the area. “Hm?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s expression turned unsightly; he didn’t expect such a strong reaction from the consciousness of the Immortal Realm. He had only come to probe; instead, he was directly expelled. …

Time has passed.

In the blink of an eye, more than ninety years have flown by.

In a void far from the Immortal Realm,

Lin Yuan’s figure stopped. “The residence time is almost up.”

Lin Yuan looked around the boundless void.

In these ninety-plus years, through his continuous exploration, he unexpectedly discovered four worlds that, while slightly weaker than the Immortal Realm, transcend the Spirit Realm.

Lin Yuan casually spread the teachings of the Martial Tao in these four worlds. “The Martial Tao in the Immortal Realm is not in any trouble.”

Even across infinite time and space, Lin Yuan could still clearly sense the situation in the Immortal Realm; he left a incarnation there specifically for this purpose. “It’s time to go back.”

With a slight intention from Lin Yuan, a ‘clock’ shaped weapon with an ancient aura appeared in front of him.

It was Lin Yuan’s Origin Clock.

This Origin Clock, which had been cultivated since Lin Yuan was at the Sixth or Seventh Layer, has now reached the peak of the Eleventh Layer. “Turning all the power of this physical body into Origin and infusing it into the Origin Clock may not transform it into a Twelfth Layer weapon, but it should be close enough.”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself. “Let’s begin.”

The energies within Lin Yuan began to collapse gradually.

With the strength of his current physical body, taking it back to the Main Universe would require an immense amount of World-Breaking Origin Force; thus, he simply decided to turn it into nourishment for the transformation of the Origin Clock.

One year later.

Lin Yuan’s physical body and soul had entirely transformed into the most fundamental Primal Force, fusing into the ‘clock’ shaped weapon.

The next moment,

Lin Yuan’s spirit will was drawn, surging into the grand and glorious Myriad Realms Gate deep within his consciousness.
